references.name: Momento · Exterior corner
references.notes: Observed: blue brick street face with three windows, solid blue sign infill on chamfered corner, opaque blue side door and separate glazed entrance. Proposed shell is 9 by 8 source-grid cells with a 3-cell SE chamfer, oriented to show both street fronts in the isometric camera. Dimensions, rear walls and connection behind the side door are inferred. No measured grid scale. Current textures/window heights are provisional; not a passed fidelity review.

annotations.label: Three facade windows
annotations.notes: Observed: three separate dark-framed windows along the blue brick street face. Current window heights and blue color remain approximate.

annotations.label: Closed corner sign panel
annotations.notes: Observed: blue brick infill with painted logo, no door leaf or handle. Preserve solid chamfered corner. Current plain blue brick is an unfinished material study.

annotations.label: Blue side door
annotations.notes: Observed: opaque blue side door. Whether it is a normal customer route is unconfirmed; internal connection is inferred.

annotations.label: Glazed street entrance
annotations.notes: Observed: separate glazed opening to the right of the blue door. Adopted customer entrance for the walkable study; use requires route validation.

annotations.label: Upper dark masonry shell
annotations.notes: Photo shows upper dark masonry. Shared footprint, roof and floor height are provisional. Interior is an undivided inferred space; windows and upper silhouette remain pending.

annotations.label: Two film-covered upper openings
annotations.notes: Two covered openings visible. Now two-cell operable assemblies with separate hosted sheeting and a masonry pier between them. Dimensions and placement remain grid approximations; full upper height is cropped in the photograph.

annotations.label: Four stools and concrete blocks
annotations.notes: Four stools and blocks observed. Provisional grey paving now follows the clipped building corner. Brick texture and curb elevations remain pending. Canopy belongs to exterior stair entry; glazed door is a single-leaf approximation.

annotations.label: Red exposed service pipe and meter
annotations.notes: Red pipe and grey meter are visible. Editable straight and diagonal modules now wrap the upper facades; ground riser and meter are approximations. Precise joint geometry and dimensions remain uncalibrated. Decorative only; no working fuel network.

annotations.label: White open-door symbol on blue corner panel
annotations.notes: Photo-observed painted door symbol recreated as a reusable attached graphic. Position and proportions approximate; not a functional door.

references.name: Momento · Coffee bar
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily gallery 3 · photograph _6
references.notes: Observed: dark curved timber counter, grinder, espresso machine, kettle and cups; white brick walls, grey tiled floor, pendant lights, hanging plant and exposed ceiling conduits. Hidden service clearances and exact dimensions remain unknown.

annotations.label: Service counter
annotations.notes: Shared subject: service-counter. Dark vertical timber cladding, rounded front corner and returning side. Same counter as Counter reverse; not a second assembly. Dimensions are not measured.

annotations.label: Coffee grinder
annotations.notes: Shared subject: coffee-grinder. Hopper, cylindrical body and tapered stand. Same machine as Counter reverse.

annotations.label: Espresso machine
annotations.notes: Visible behind the grinder along the counter return. Stacked cups above. Exact spacing and operating clearance are inferred.

annotations.label: Front pendant
annotations.notes: Dark cone shade with warm interior. Reusable ceiling fixture, clear of floor movement. Grid location and hanging height provisional.

annotations.label: Kettle and pour-over drippers
annotations.notes: Observed kettle and glass drippers beside the shared grinder. Reusable decorative kit; exact spacing inferred. Does not implement brewing.

annotations.label: Stacked paper cups
annotations.notes: Observed cups on counter return. The reusable cups/menu combination approximates small service details; the menu stand is not established by this photo.

annotations.label: Rear pendant
annotations.notes: Second suspended cone shade. Distinct from the small wall-mounted light further back, which is still missing. Placement provisional.

annotations.label: Trailing hanging planter
annotations.notes: Observed hanging terracotta pot with trailing foliage. Species not identified. Current grid position and dimensions inferred.

annotations.label: Provisional ceiling support
annotations.notes: Photo establishes an overhead ceiling, but not the full upper building. Current flat top supplies attachment support only; material, height and upper-storey construction remain unresolved.

annotations.label: Rear bracket lamp
annotations.notes: Small dark cone on a wall bracket behind the espresso area, distinct from two ceiling pendants. Asset is wall-supported and switchable. Current rear-wall position/distance to the espresso counter remain provisional.

annotations.label: Provisional overhead conduit route
annotations.notes: Photo shows exposed light-colored overhead conduit. Editable straight and tee pieces now connect the two pendant positions to the room boundaries. Full topology and exact routing are inferred, not surveyed; no electrical-network simulation is claimed.

references.name: Momento · Adjoining wall
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily gallery 5 · photograph _9
references.notes: Observed: dark doorway on a raised threshold, brown wall panel, full-height curtain, exposed conduit and adjacent coffee equipment. The room behind the door and the area behind the curtain are unknown; do not assign a bathroom or storage function without more evidence.

annotations.label: Raised dark door
annotations.notes: Observed dark leaf and raised step beside the bar. Reusable editable threshold is now present and traversable; chosen height/depth are provisional, not measured from the photo. Grid location and hidden rear strip remain inferred; hidden room function unknown.

annotations.label: Brown wall panel
annotations.notes: Observed broad brown wall surface beside the dark door. Linked first of two contiguous umber plaster wall segments. Position/proportion inferred; conduit and exact panel width remain unresolved.

annotations.label: Full-height charcoal curtain
annotations.notes: Observed dark pleated fabric to the right of the brown panel. Current wall-mounted covering follows an inferred partition end. No hidden exit or window is asserted; exact extent/position remains approximate.

annotations.label: Exposed twin conduit
annotations.notes: Observed light-painted conduit above the doorway and brown partition. Linked first of five editable segments; final segment includes an upward turn near the curtain. Height, depth and hidden circuit routing are provisional, not measured. Electrical connectivity is not simulated.

references.name: Momento · Counter reverse
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily photograph _8
references.notes: Observed: twin dark-framed windows, continuous sill, wall-mounted product shelves, tall cabinet, menu board and cups on curved counter, grinder, ceiling spots and pendant. Grinder and counter match the coffee-bar view; approximate camera relationship needs annotation.

annotations.label: Service counter
annotations.notes: Shared subject: service-counter. Reverse side of the rounded counter; menu and cups sit on its surface. Lower/right extent is cropped.

annotations.label: Coffee grinder
annotations.notes: Shared subject: coffee-grinder. Opposite side of the same grinder. Keep one supported scene object.

annotations.label: Paired windows and sill
annotations.notes: Two adjacent tall dark-framed windows separated by a white brick pier. A continuous sill runs below both. Do not merge into one uninterrupted glass sheet.

annotations.label: Product display shelves
annotations.notes: Observed open wall-mounted dark shelving left of the paired windows. Reusable three-tier approximation; exact size/position inferred. Package identities are unreadable: coffee stock is an explicit gameplay assumption.

annotations.label: Continuous dark window sill
annotations.notes: Observed continuous sill below paired windows. Linked entity is the first of five modular rail segments across the current street-window run. Current height follows the provisional high-window profile; measured height and spacing remain unresolved.

references.name: Momento · Architect floor plan
references.source: Studio Hoon / Hoon Lee · A-01 · 06 Jun 2019 · ArchDaily floor plan
references.notes: Published plan establishes separate bar and exhibition areas, entry on the bar-side facade, stair enclosure and small bathroom. The previous photo-only layout is superseded. Printed A3 1:50 is not a verified digital pixel calibration; exact metres remain unset.

annotations.label: Bar / exhibition divider
annotations.notes: Published plan separates the paired-window bar bay from single-window exhibition bay. Linked first of three editable divider segments. Rotated plan into current model axes; integer-grid length and exact position remain approximate.

annotations.label: Curved front counter
annotations.notes: Counter orientation and side of room corrected using the architect plan. Replaced oversized 3x3 prefab with generic 2x2 variant after actual walkthrough found a blocked staff route. Rear preparation run added; appliance positions remain approximate, not metrically calibrated.

annotations.label: Bar-side entrance
annotations.notes: Relocated to bar-side facade from architect plan. Keyboard entry and exhibition exit verified in 203. Grid dimensions remain approximate.

annotations.label: Internal bathroom
annotations.notes: Enclosure and inner door follow plan topology. Sink and toilet use existing catalogue approximations; exact fixture design not visible in photos. Access and sink panel verified; drink action was canceled by movement.

annotations.label: Return staircase — approximate geometry
annotations.notes: Generic 3x2 left-return stair added through the workshop. Actual browser ascent to floor1 and descent to ground verified. Tread dimensions/material are approximations; upper destination is provisional roof/landing, not a reconstructed upper building. Guards and visibility from above remain incomplete.

annotations.label: Preparation sink at rear worktop
annotations.notes: Sink position is visible in the architect floor plan. Cabinet finish, faucet and exact dimensions are inferred; editable source-grid module, not a metric reconstruction.
